description: This file defines a read-only, sorted, non-overlapping collection of RingRange objects, primarily used to manage and query ranges within a ring or circular UUID space in Orleans runtime. It includes methods for creating, checking containment, intersection, difference, and serialization of rings.

classes.name: RingRangeCollection
classes.description: An immutable, sorted collection of non-overlapping ring ranges used to represent segments within a circular space in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new RingRangeCollection from a collection of RingRange objects, filtering out empty ranges and sorting them.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given grain ID or uint value is within any of the ranges.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Determines whether a given RingRange or another RingRangeCollection overlaps with any range in the collection.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Calculates the set difference between this collection and a previous collection, returning ranges present in this collection but not in the previous.
